description: This file implements core functions for the Ansc Low-level Protocol Controller (Lpcco) TCP Object, including enrollment, unbinding, and connecting to a manager, for the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It handles establishing and tearing down TCP connections with LPC managers and parties, managing socket creation, and maintaining party address information.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpEnroll(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls the TCP object into the LPC framework, adding local party address info and connecting to the LPC manager if in client mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpUnbind(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Unbinds the TCP object from the LPC framework, sending BYE messages to connected parties and resetting the object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpConnectToManager(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket to connect to the LPC manager and performs handshake if in client mode.
